tools.name: corpusfetch_fetch_record
tools.description: Fetch the body of a CorpusFetch record. Format 'md' (default, ~1500 tokens) or 'py' (zero-prose stdlib slice, ~300 tokens). Prefer warrant-first: call corpusfetch_fetch_warrant before this.

tools.name: corpusfetch_fetch_warrant
tools.description: Fetch the ~220-token warrant (precondition seal) for a CorpusFetch record. Fetch this before the .md record. If the seal fails, do not fetch the record.

tools.name: corpusfetch_lookup_exception
tools.description: Route a Python exception class to candidate record addresses in the CorpusFetch pillar. Returns warrant_url, py_url, md_url, and fetch_when for each candidate. Fetch the warrant first (~220 tokens); if its seal fails, do not fetch the .md.

tools.name: corpusfetch_lookup_symptom
tools.description: Route a runtime symptom to candidate record addresses in the CorpusFetch pillar. Returns warrant_url, py_url, md_url, and fetch_when for each candidate. Fetch the warrant first (~220 tokens); if its seal fails, do not fetch the .md.
